mapper.sql: SELECT file_id AS id, filename AS name, 'FILE' AS resource_type, 'upload' AS source_type, COALESCE(processing_status, '') AS status, NULL AS description, NULL AS source_filename, content_type, size, 0 AS content_length, 0 AS chunk_count, uploaded_at AS created_at, processed_at AS updated_at, processing_error AS error_message FROM file_metadata WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT knowledge_id AS id, name, 'KNOWLEDGE' AS resource_type, source_type, 'INDEXED' AS status, description, source_filename, NULL AS content_type, 0 AS size, content_length, chunk_count, created_at, updated_at, NULL AS error_message FROM knowledge_entry WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}

where.if: (LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(name, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(description, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(source_filename, ''))) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(COALESCE(content_type, ''))) > 0)

mapper.select: SELECT page.id, page.name, page.resource_type, page.source_type, page.status, page.description, page.source_filename, page.content_type, page.size, CASE WHEN page.resource_type = 'FILE' THEN CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(f.content, '')) ELSE page.content_length END AS content_length, page.chunk_count, page.created_at, page.updated_at, page.error_message FROM ( SELECT * FROM () assets ORDER BY created_at DESC, resource_type DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageable.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageable.offset} ) page LEFT JOIN file_metadata f ON page.resource_type = 'FILE' AND f.file_id = page.id AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY page.created_at DESC, page.resource_type DESC, page.id DESC

SELECT SUM(file_count + knowledge_count) AS total_assets, SUM(file_count) AS file_count, SUM(knowledge_count) AS knowledge_count, SUM(chunks) AS indexed_chunk_count, SUM(storage_bytes) AS total_storage_bytes, SUM(failed_count) AS failed_file_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS file_count, 0 AS knowledge_count, 0 AS chunks, COALESCE(SUM(size), 0) AS storage_bytes, COALESCE(SUM(processing_status = 'FAILED'), 0) AS failed_count FROM file_metadata WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS file_count, COUNT(*) AS knowledge_count, COALESCE(SUM(chunk_count), 0) AS chunks, COALESCE(SUM(content_length), 0) AS storage_bytes, 0 AS failed_count FROM knowledge_entry WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ) totals
